1.why: Clean sans-serif headings and labels with adequate line spacing on the cards, though the monospace secret/log text is small and tightly set.

2.why: No italics or all-caps are used and instructional copy is one or two short sentences, but the wrapped otpauth provisioning URI and the log panel form dense character blocks.

3.why: All screenshots are of a fixed-width 1280px desktop layout; no mobile rendering is shown and the long unbroken secret/otpauth strings would likely overflow a narrow phone viewport.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Use an authenticator app to generate a code' are brief, though terms like 'protected one-way verification values' are jargon.

5.why: Only the recovery code field shows a format example (placeholder 'ABCDE-23489'); the verification code and authenticator code fields show no example.

6.why: Every screen's readable content is a heading plus a short sentence or callout, so no long passage must be read to proceed (the Logs panel is optional).

7.why: No copy buttons or copy-all affordance appear beside the manual setup secret, provisioning value, or the eight recovery codes, so the user must select or retype them by hand.

8.why: No QR code is displayed anywhere; the banner explicitly says 'Authenticator created. Add this value manually.' with only a text secret and otpauth URI.

9.why: Nothing in the screens indicates autofill/password-manager support (no one-time-code hints or manager icons), and code fields appear as plain inputs.

10.why: Each card has a bold heading and a single blue primary button, but there is no step indicator or progress marker showing where the user is in the enrolment flow.

11.why: Most screens ask one action, but step 4 presents two input fields at once and steps 6 and 8 present two competing buttons (Regenerate/Log out, Verify/Generate).

12.why: Confirmations like 'Authenticator created' and 'Recovery code confirmed.' state what happened but do not say what the next step is.

13.why: Retrying a form is possible, but recovery codes are 'Shown once' with no reveal/hide or re-display option, and regenerating consumes an unused code as a penalty.

14.why: The only error shown, 'Unable to complete this request. Please try again.', names neither the problem nor a fix, although it does not blame the user.

15.why: No countdown, timer, or expiry warning appears on any screen and the TOTP period is set to 120 seconds, giving generous entry time.
